WITH store_sales AS (

        d.CalendarYear,
        SUM(fs.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount

same_store AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2008) AS sales_2008,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2009) AS sales_2009
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY StoreKey
    HAVING countIf(CalendarYear = 2008) > 0
       AND countIf(CalendarYear = 2009) > 0
       AND sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2009) < sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2008)
),
top_stores AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sales_2008,
        sales_2009,
        sales_2008 - sales_2009 AS store_decline_amt,
        (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / sales_2008 * 100 AS store_decline_pct
    FROM same_store
    ORDER BY store_decline_pct DESC, store_decline_amt DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        fs.StoreKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        d.CalendarYear,
        SUM(fs.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactSales fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON fs.DateKey = d.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = toFloat64(ps.ProductSubcategoryKey)
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY fs.StoreKey, pc.ProductCategoryName, d.CalendarYear
),
category_trend AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2008) AS cat_sales_2008,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2009) AS cat_sales_2009,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2008) - sumIf(SalesAmount, CalendarYear = 2009) AS category_decline_amt

        ts.StoreKey,

        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ts.StoreKey
            ORDER BY ct.category_decline_amt DESC, ct.ProductCategoryName
        ) AS rn
    FROM top_stores ts

FROM ranked

ORDER BY store_decline_pct DESC;

    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009

    FROM retail.FactInventory
